sloka: निगृहीतः त्वया ब्रह्मन् विश्वामित्रो महातपाः ।प्रसीद जपताम् श्रेष्ठ लोकाः सन्तु गत व्यथाः ॥१-५६-२१॥
transliteration: nigṛhītaḥ tvayā brahman viśvāmitro mahātapāḥ ।prasīda japatām śreṣṭha lokāḥ santu gata vyathāḥ ॥1-56-21॥

translations.english: 'O Brahman great ascetic Viswamitra was controlled by you. O Best of ascetics be pleased and let the worlds be delivered from distress'.
